text:
Diego Marquez: FYI payment failed for client BrightWell (acct xxxx-8899). card declined at initial authorization. invoices BW-9981, BW-9982.
Anya Patel: what's decline code? any retry attempts?
billing-bot: auto-alert: payment_method=card_last4=8899 status=declined code=insufficient_funds attempts=1
Ravi Kapoor: they were on net30 but their card was used for a late autopay. CS said they changed finance contact last week.
CS-Rep-Jordan: i've DM'd the new AP contact, asked for update: alt card, wire, or ACH. offered a 3-day grace window while we await confirmation.
Diego Marquez: please do not auto-retry multiple times. set one immediate retry and then pause. hold dunning for 72h.
billing-bot: action logged: auto_retry=attempted timestamp=1772156795 result=failed
Anya Patel: recording next steps: 1) ask for remittance or proof of wire when they choose wire; 2) provide our minimal wire template (no full acct in slack); 3) if they pick ACH, send ACH link + pdf authorization.
CS-Rep-Jordan: client responded: "we hit a temporary cashflow pinch, will wire today EOD, expect funds within 2 business days. attached bank-proof.pdf"
Ravi Kapoor: uploaded bank-proof.pdf to ticket BILL-3421. can someone mark invoices as pending_wire and add tags: pending, brightwell?
Diego Marquez: done. invoices marked pending_wire. tag=client_pending tag=wire_expected.
Anya Patel: note for reconciliation: request remittance email that lists invoice numbers and amounts. we'll reconcile once funds land and apply to oldest invoices first.
Ravi Kapoor: added note to BILL-3421: "expect settlement 48-72h per client". scheduled manual follow-up reminder in 72h.
Diego Marquez: if wire doesn't clear in 72h, escalate to AR and open a short-term service hold review (threshold $50k). current balance ~32,400 so no immediate hold.
Anya Patel: also capture the card decline reason in CRM and flag for billing ops to reduce auto-retries for this account.
billing-bot: reminder set: check_ticket=BILL-3421 remind_at=1772159390
CS-Rep-Jordan: sent client the wire template and ACH link: https://billing.redwood.ai/ach-setup. client acknowledged.
Diego Marquez: thanks. closing loop here but leave ticket open until remittance received. I'll update AR queue if no settle by Day4. :thumbsup:
Anya Patel: noted. end.
